standing--noun.def: The rank or reputation a person or group holds among others.
standing--noun.ex: The scandal damaged her standing in the party.

exact--verb.def: To force someone to give you something, such as money or revenge.
exact--verb.ex: The gang exacted money from local shops.
exact--verb.exTr: Çete yerel dükkânlardan zorla para aldı.

secure--verb.def: To obtain something after effort, or to fix something firmly.
secure--verb.ex: She secured a loan for the new factory.

corpse--noun.def: The dead body of a human being.
corpse--noun.ex: Divers found the corpse near the bridge.

brief--noun.def: A set of written instructions or facts prepared for someone.
brief--noun.ex: The lawyer read the brief overnight.

bout--noun.def: A short period of illness or intense activity.
bout--noun.ex: A bout of flu kept him home.
bout--noun.exTr: Bir grip nöbeti onu evde tuttu.

temper--verb.def: To make something less extreme by adding an opposite quality.
temper--verb.ex: He tempered his criticism with praise.

counsel--noun.def: Formal advice, or the lawyer representing a party in court.

ally--verb.def: To join with another group for mutual support.
ally--verb.ex: The union allied itself with the students.

echo--noun.def: A sound that returns after striking a surface.
echo--noun.ex: Her voice left an echo in the hall.

echo--verb.def: To repeat a sound, or to repeat another person's words or ideas.

interrogation--noun.def: The act of questioning someone closely, often by police.

phantom--noun.def: A ghost, or something imagined that seems real.
phantom--noun.ex: He chased a phantom of his own making.
phantom--noun.exTr: Kendi yarattığı bir hayaletin peşinden koştu.

ironic--adj.def: Saying the opposite of what is meant, or oddly contrary to expectation.
ironic--adj.ex: It is ironic that the fire station burned.

proposition--noun.def: A plan or offer put forward for consideration.
proposition--noun.ex: The bank rejected his business proposition.

cosmic--adj.def: Relating to the universe, or vast in scale.

hysterical--adj.def: Unable to control emotion because of fear or excitement.
hysterical--adj.ex: The crowd grew hysterical at the news.

mold--verb.def: To shape a soft material, or to influence how someone develops.
mold--verb.ex: A good coach molds young players.
mold--verb.exTr: İyi bir antrenör genç oyuncuları biçimlendirir.

antidote--noun.def: A substance that stops a poison, or a remedy for something bad.
antidote--noun.ex: Doctors gave him the antidote at once.

utter--adj.def: Complete, used to stress how total something is.
utter--adj.ex: The evening ended in utter chaos.

solitary--adj.def: Alone, or done without the company of others.
solitary--adj.ex: He took a solitary walk along the shore.
solitary--adj.exTr: Kıyı boyunca tek başına bir yürüyüş yaptı.

solitary--noun.def: Imprisonment in a cell away from all other prisoners.
solitary--noun.ex: They put him in solitary for a month.
solitary--noun.exTr: Onu bir ay hücre hapsine koydular.

dwarf--verb.def: To make something else look small by comparison.
dwarf--verb.ex: The new tower dwarfs the old church.
dwarf--verb.exTr: Yeni kule eski kiliseyi cüce gösteriyor.

hull--noun.def: The main body of a ship or boat.
hull--noun.ex: The rocks tore a hole in the hull.

informant--noun.def: Someone who gives information, often secretly, to authorities.

tactical--adj.def: Planned carefully to gain an advantage in a particular situation.
tactical--adj.ex: Leaving early was a tactical decision.

idle--verb.def: To run slowly without doing work, as an engine does.
idle--verb.ex: The taxi idled outside the station.

transmitter--noun.def: A device that sends out radio or television signals.
transmitter--noun.ex: Storms knocked out the main transmitter.
transmitter--noun.exTr: Fırtınalar ana vericiyi devre dışı bıraktı.

merit--noun.def: The quality of deserving praise, reward or attention.
merit--noun.ex: Promotions here are based on merit.

merit--verb.def: To deserve a particular kind of treatment or attention.
merit--verb.ex: The complaint merits a proper answer.
merit--verb.exTr: Şikâyet düzgün bir yanıtı hak ediyor.

hitch--verb.def: To fasten one thing to another with a rope or hook.
hitch--verb.ex: He hitched the trailer to the truck.

gale--noun.ex: A gale tore the roof off the shed.

hazard--verb.def: To risk something, or to offer a guess that may be wrong.
hazard--verb.ex: I would hazard a guess at fifty.

eminence--noun.def: The state of being famous and respected in a field.
eminence--noun.ex: She reached eminence as a surgeon.
eminence--noun.exTr: Cerrah olarak seçkin bir konuma ulaştı.

legion--noun.def: A large body of soldiers, or a great number of people.
legion--noun.ex: A legion of fans waited outside.
legion--noun.exTr: Dışarıda kalabalık bir hayran topluluğu bekledi.

plum--adj.def: Highly desirable and easy to enjoy, said of a job or role.
plum--adj.ex: He landed a plum post in Rome.
plum--adj.exTr: Roma'da çok istenen bir göreve kondu.

solitude--noun.def: The state of being alone, often by choice.
solitude--noun.ex: He writes best in complete solitude.
solitude--noun.exTr: En iyi, tam bir yalnızlık içinde yazar.

residue--noun.def: What remains after most of something has gone.
residue--noun.ex: A sticky residue covered the pan.

vicinity--noun.def: The area near or around a particular place.
vicinity--noun.ex: No shops exist in the vicinity.

brink--noun.def: The point just before something serious happens.
brink--noun.ex: The firm stood on the brink of collapse.

interrogate--verb.def: To question someone closely and often aggressively.
interrogate--verb.ex: They interrogated the driver for hours.

scroll--noun.def: A roll of paper or parchment with writing on it.
scroll--noun.ex: The museum displays an ancient scroll.

deliberate--verb.def: To think or discuss carefully before deciding.
deliberate--verb.exTr: Jüri gece yarısına dek müzakere etti.

marvel--noun.def: Something that causes great wonder or admiration.
marvel--noun.ex: The bridge is a marvel of engineering.

pluck--noun.def: Courage shown in a difficult situation.
pluck--noun.ex: It took pluck to speak up.

surge--verb.def: To rise or move forward suddenly and powerfully.

menace--noun.def: A person or thing likely to cause harm.
menace--noun.ex: Speeding drivers are a menace here.
menace--noun.exTr: Hız yapan sürücüler burada bir tehdit.

treacherous--adj.def: Disloyal, or dangerous in a way that is hard to see.
treacherous--adj.ex: The path grew treacherous after rain.
treacherous--adj.exTr: Yol yağmurdan sonra tehlikeli hale geldi.

bogus--adj.def: False, though made to look genuine.
bogus--adj.ex: He paid with a bogus cheque.

splinter--verb.def: To break into sharp thin pieces, or to split into rival groups.
splinter--verb.ex: The party splintered before the election.

melancholy--noun.def: A deep and lasting sadness without clear cause.
melancholy--noun.ex: A quiet melancholy filled the house.

melancholy--adj.def: Feeling or expressing a thoughtful sadness.

hypothesis--noun.def: An idea proposed as a starting point for testing.

helm--noun.def: The wheel that steers a ship, or the position of leadership.
helm--noun.ex: She took the helm of the company.

gravitational--adj.def: Relating to the force that pulls objects toward each other.
gravitational--adj.ex: The moon has a weak gravitational pull.

tactic--noun.def: A particular method used to reach a short-term goal.

vermin--noun.def: Small animals or insects that damage crops or carry disease.
vermin--noun.ex: The barn was overrun with vermin.

rift--noun.def: A wide crack, or a serious break in a relationship.
rift--noun.ex: The argument opened a rift between them.

treachery--noun.def: Behaviour that betrays someone who trusted you.
treachery--noun.ex: His treachery cost the town dearly.

herald--verb.def: To be a sign that something is about to come.
herald--verb.ex: Swallows herald the arrival of spring.

herald--noun.def: A person or thing that announces what is coming.
herald--noun.ex: The frost was a herald of winter.

artifact--noun.def: An object made by people, especially one of historical interest.

posture--verb.def: To behave in a way meant to impress rather than to act sincerely.
posture--verb.ex: Both sides postured for the cameras.
posture--verb.exTr: İki taraf da kameralar için poz kesti.

ore--noun.def: Rock from which metal can be taken.

knack--noun.def: A natural skill for doing something well.
knack--noun.ex: She has a knack for calming people.

trifle--noun.def: Something of very little value or importance.
trifle--noun.exTr: Önemsiz bir şey yüzünden kavga ettiler.

trifle--verb.def: To treat someone or something without the seriousness deserved.
trifle--verb.ex: Do not trifle with his patience.

vortex--noun.def: A whirling mass of water, air or events that pulls things in.
vortex--noun.ex: The boat spun into the vortex.

moor--noun.def: Open high ground covered with rough grass and heather.

mercenary--noun.def: A soldier who fights for any country that pays.

rebound--verb.def: To bounce back after hitting something, or to recover after a fall.
rebound--verb.ex: Share prices rebounded within a week.
rebound--verb.exTr: Hisse fiyatları bir hafta içinde toparlandı.

rebound--noun.def: The movement of something bouncing back.
rebound--noun.ex: He caught the rebound under the basket.

provincial--adj.def: Belonging to the provinces, or narrow in outlook.
provincial--adj.ex: His tastes struck them as provincial.

hypothetical--adj.def: Imagined for the sake of argument rather than real.

prone--adj.def: Likely to suffer from or do something bad.
prone--adj.ex: The coast is prone to flooding.

disperse--verb.def: To spread out over a wide area, or to make a crowd do so.

calamity--noun.def: An event causing great damage or suffering.
calamity--noun.ex: The drought was a national calamity.

impeccable--adj.def: Without any fault or error at all.

audit--verb.def: To examine financial records officially for accuracy.
audit--verb.ex: An outside firm audits our books.

malicious--adj.def: Intended to hurt or upset someone deliberately.
